reason: MOLT is a command-line coding-agent workflow that executes tasks, reflects on reusable patterns, generates and tests skills, and stores them for later reuse.

summaries.zh: MOLT 是一个命令行编码智能体工作流工具，可执行开发任务、生成并测试可复用技能，并将其保存到技能库中。
summaries.en: MOLT is a command-line coding-agent workflow that executes development tasks, creates and tests reusable skills, and stores them in a skill library.

capabilities: Runs coding-agent tasks through an OpenAI-compatible model
Executes shell commands and generated Python skills
Creates, tests, stores, exports, installs, and publishes reusable skills
